title: Exercise for Fat Loss
subtitle: Evidence, mechanisms, practical application, progression, and safety considerations for exercise for fat loss
evidence_strength: Established evidence from systematic reviews and randomized controlled trials supports combined aerobic and resistance training for fat loss, with emerging evidence on HIIT effectiveness. Limitations exist when exercise is not paired with dietary management. Safety considerations are well-established in exercise science literature.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
